names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 8 Αυγούστου, «Άγιοι Δύο Μάρτυρες από την Τύρο», with the rank word «Άγιοι» left off. «Μάρτυρες» is kept because nothing of the company's designation would remain without it; the page names neither of the two.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 8ης Αυγούστου — «Άγιοι Δύο Μάρτυρες από την Τύρο»

attestations.note: A company of two the page does not enumerate — it names neither of them — so this is one folder and not two. The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 8 Αυγούστου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on it. It prints no year and no hymn of any kind, and the whole of its notice is the manner of their death.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (1 October 2026).
